tasks.title: NDA Loophole Detection
tasks.submission: JSON or structured text mapping the specific clauses.
tasks.assignment: Review a deliberately flawed Non-Disclosure Agreement and identify the 3 loopholes.
tasks.ai_review: The AI uses strict NLP matching to verify whether the student caught critical issues such as the missing Survival Clause.

tasks.title: SaaS Data Consent Form
tasks.assignment: Draft a data consent form for a new SaaS startup.
tasks.ai_review: The AI grades against a strict legal rubric, requiring exact phrases like Data Fiduciary, Explicit Consent, and Right to Erasure.

tasks.title: Typeform-to-Contract Workflow
tasks.assignment: Build an automated workflow where filling out a Typeform instantly generates a customized PDF employment contract.
tasks.ai_review: The AI submits a mock Typeform and expects a perfectly formatted 200 OK payload containing the mapped variables.

tasks.title: AI Company Legal Pack
tasks.assignment: Submit a comprehensive Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and an API licensing agreement for an AI company.
tasks.ai_review: The AI evaluates the documents for IP protection, indemnification strength, and API abuse limitations, acting as a Senior Corporate Counsel.
